issue.title: Retire codex_explicit_instructions
issue.description: Deliver the Codex root bundle through developer_instructions and suppress SASE native instruction duplicates.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Remove the disabled branch after at least seven days of clean explicit-run readout and instruction conformance on the execution hosts.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Use the legacy single-turn developer instruction and native discovery while applying the shadow-home allowlist.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Pass the whole rendered root bundle through Codex developer_instructions, disable project docs in SASE-managed projects, suppress exact SASE-owned home instruction files, and declare the subagent slot inherits_root.
